verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 67.7 (-6.1% in a day) and momentum is 40: prices are falling. 84s cost 950, 85s 3,000 and 86s 5,900. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-23T14:36:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Désiré Doué 87 Star Performer after its 32% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 1,230,000 coins. Now 1,253,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 31.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 14 of 23 so far, averaging +6.0% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Otávio 80 after its 47% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 54,500 coins. Now 78,500. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 47.3% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 7 of 13 so far, averaging +7.5% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-26T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 950 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 85s 3,000 (1.43 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,900 (1.44 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,400 (1.35 coins per Item Score point), 88s 13,750 (1.66 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 87s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Ronaldo and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Ronaldo 94 Base Icon -27.9%; Désiré Doué 87 Star Performer -24.1%; Tarik Muharemović 75 Rare -23.8%; Melchie Dumornay 89 Team of the week -23.6%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
